tasks.title: Support Custom Replacement for Unpaired Surrogates
tasks.prompt: Extend encodeUrl(url, options) in index.js so that if options.replacement is specified (e.g. options = { replacement: '?' }), unpaired surrogate pairs are replaced with options.replacement instead of the default '\uFFFD'.
tasks.description: Custom replacement string for unpaired surrogates

tasks.title: Export isEncoded Helper Function
tasks.prompt: Export an isEncoded(url) helper function as encodeUrl.isEncoded in index.js that returns true if the input URL requires no additional percent-encoding (i.e. encodeUrl(url) === String(url)), and false otherwise.

tasks.title: Export Internal RegExps
tasks.prompt: Export ENCODE_CHARS_REGEXP and UNMATCHED_SURROGATE_PAIR_REGEXP on encodeUrl as encodeUrl.ENCODE_CHARS_REGEXP and encodeUrl.UNMATCHED_SURROGATE_PAIR_REGEXP in index.js.

tasks.title: Export component Helper Method
tasks.prompt: Implement and export encodeUrl.component(str) in index.js that applies encodeURIComponent to non-URL code points while preserving existing valid percent-encoded hex sequences.

tasks.title: Support Trim Option
tasks.prompt: Extend encodeUrl(url, options) in index.js to support options.trim. When options.trim === true, leading and trailing whitespace characters in the url are trimmed before encoding.

tasks.title: Handle Non-String Inputs and Objects Cleanly
tasks.prompt: Ensure encodeUrl(url) in index.js handles null and undefined by returning empty string '' instead of stringifying them to 'null' or 'undefined'.
tasks.description: Safe handling of null and undefined inputs

tasks.title: Export decodeUrl Safe Decoder Function
tasks.prompt: Implement and export encodeUrl.decodeUrl(url) in index.js which decodes percent-encoded UTF-8 sequences safely without throwing URIError on invalid sequences (invalid sequences are left intact or decoded with decodeURI fallback).

tasks.title: Expose Package Version Property
tasks.prompt: Expose a version property on the exported encodeUrl function (encodeUrl.version) in index.js set to the string '2.0.0'.

tasks.title: Support Space as Plus Option
tasks.prompt: Extend encodeUrl(url, options) in index.js to support options.spaceAsPlus. When options.spaceAsPlus === true, raw space characters ' ' are encoded as '+' instead of '%20'.

tasks.title: Export isAllowedChar Helper
tasks.prompt: Implement and export encodeUrl.isAllowedChar(codePoint) in index.js that takes an integer character code and returns true if it is an allowed unencoded URL character per ENCODE_CHARS_REGEXP rules.
